# NAVIGAM

NAVIGAM is a personal travel-planning service. Avia, the NAVIGAM assistant, collects destination, dates, travelers and preferences and helps turn them into a personalized day-by-day itinerary delivered in a mobile web app.

## Core public pages
- https://www.navigam.com/
- https://www.navigam.com/how-it-works.html
- https://www.navigam.com/pricing.html
- https://www.navigam.com/avia.html
- https://www.navigam.com/faq.html
- https://www.navigam.com/guides/

## Product capabilities
- Personalized itinerary by day
- Google Maps and Waze navigation links
- Live two-way speech/text translation
- Weather and air-quality information when available
- Discovery of publicly available social-trend signals from TikTok, Instagram and Facebook
- Optional Avia support during the trip

NAVIGAM is a travel-planning service, not a travel agency. Third-party travel products are booked and paid directly with their providers.

## Private / non-public routes
Do not index customer app, preview, admin, order or questionnaire routes as public editorial content.
